name: The Gallowmother
place: dungeon crypt_spiral: floor 2's mini-boss (the last ring room, 24 m square)
_doc: Stream E. A huge owl nesting in the burial ring. P1: dives on whoever she fancies (the circle leads the target — keep moving), a feather storm you dodge by getting under her, and an interruptible hoot that fears the whole room. P2 at 45% 'The Roost': she takes to her perch behind a ward of feathers while owlets mob you; kill them to bring her down. Two gibbet posts give cover from her hoot if it gets off. Soft enrage from 3 minutes.
party: Solo: hard in the Roost (3 owlet adds) — bring a follower. 2-3: intended. 5: the dive/feather storm are easy; two gibbet posts are too little cover for five if the hoot lands. M5 scaling: owlets 3 -> 2 solo / 4 at five; add a third post at five.

pull: A pair of lamp-yellow eyes opens in the dark above you.
Something enormous shifts its feathers. Bones rattle down from the rafters.
say.death: The Gallowmother tumbles from the dark in a storm of grey feathers.
say.reset: Feathers settle. The eyes close again.

enrage.say: The Gallowmother shrieks and tears at everything in reach!

dive.name: Silent Dive
dive.say: She drifts up into the dark... {target}, keep moving!

feather_storm.name: Feather Storm
feather_storm.say: Her wings spread wide — get underneath her!

hoot.name: Dreadful Hoot
hoot.say: The Gallowmother puffs up to hoot — interrupt her or hide behind a post!

onInterrupt.say: Her hoot cracks into a squawk.

phases.name: The Roost
phases.say: The Gallowmother flaps up to her roost. Her owlets answer!
phases.shieldDown: The last owlet falls — the Gallowmother drops from her perch, furious!

phases.name: Grounded
phases.say: Feathers everywhere. She will not fly again.
